title: ADR-0001: Write the migration tool in Rust
summary: Chose Rust (Cargo workspace) for the migration tool; external analysers run as pinned subprocesses and the LLM agent loop is also Rust.
notes: Output filename uses placeholder suffix 'hashpending' because the classifier toolset (Read/Write/Grep/Glob) has no SHA-256 facility; the 8-hex-char source hash of the full path was not computed. Rename to {slug}-{sha256(source_path)[0:8]}.json once computed.
